changes: First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 on the Modwerk base: light pad taps that stock ignores play as a soft hit.
Switch it on in the GLOBAL menu, past SYSTEM: LIGHT TAPS: ON. It is saved with the project.
Hard hits keep the pads' own velocity; a light tap plays at velocity 8, about 3 ms after the press.
Holding a pad lightly plays one soft hit, not a stream; letting go ends a retrig roll as after a firm hit.
